authorisation: Justin requested this final check after reviewing development results.
target: Last known prior basket for fixed audit customer IDs; official final test contents remain unknown.
methods: Unchanged development-fitted neighbours and popularity; no refitting or audit contribution to shared statistics.
personal_inputs: Earlier audit shopper history only, same fixed seed/score/filter/fallback/tie rules.

metrics.primary: Hit@3 averaged over ALL 15000 audit customers
metrics.precision: Matches / 3 for every customer, including short lists
metrics.conditional_novel_recall: Matches / novel target products, averaged only over customers with at least one novel target product; report denominator
metrics.novel: Absent from complete recorded pre-target personal history

gate.note: Agent-selected exploratory project criterion, not a business standard. Passing only warrants review; no automatic audit or UI change.

gate_interpretation: Same thresholds retained before audit scoring. Passing supports a prototype experiment, not proven customer benefit.
exposure: Reserved from V2/V3 development scoring; source previously loaded and summarised. Not new data or guaranteed pristine original source.
limits: Per-customer order cutoffs, no shared calendar. Shared histories have cross-customer timing ambiguity. Not causal discovery or satisfaction evidence.
after_scoring: Audit becomes exposed. No tuning or repeat fresh-test claims. V2 timing remains stopped; this is a separate discovery audit.
